item.isekai_mahou.orc_war_horn.desc: Blow it to challenge the Orc Lord. He comes with an escort.
message.isekai_mahou.orc_war_horn.alread: An Orc Lord is already nearby!
message.isekai_mahou.orc_war_horn.no_roo: There is no room for the horde to arrive here.
message.isekai_mahou.orc_war_horn.summon: War drums echo... the Orc Lord accepted the challenge!
boss.isekai_mahou.orc_lord.subtitle: Lord of the Horde
boss.isekai_mahou.orc_lord.intro: WHO DARES SET FOOT IN THE HORDE'S CAMP?!
boss.isekai_mahou.orc_lord.phase: BLOOD AND IRON! THE HORDE NEVER RETREATS!
boss.isekai_mahou.orc_lord.defeated: %s has fallen! The Horde lost its lord.
boss.isekai_mahou.minotaur.subtitle: Guardian of the Labyrinth
boss.isekai_mahou.minotaur.intro: A bellow echoes through the labyrinth halls...
boss.isekai_mahou.minotaur.phase: The Minotaur flies into a rage!
boss.isekai_mahou.minotaur.defeated: %s has been defeated! The labyrinth falls silent.
boss.isekai_mahou.orc_lord.throw: AXE TO THE HEAD! NO ONE ESCAPES THE HORDE!
command.isekai_mahou.spawnboss.cb_fail: The boss could not be summoned here.
